title: Agent-Guided Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Physics-based Validation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate, compact exchange--correlation functionals are central to predictive density functional theory. Symbolic search and language-model agents can propose new functional forms, but it remains unclear whether their gains survive self-consistency and external evaluation, whether the new terms carry physical content, whether agents outperform evolutionary search, and how language-model backbones compare. We connect frontier LLM agents to a GPU evaluator through the Model Context Protocol, with training-only fitting, persistent memory, and self-consistent and external evaluation. Opus-5.5 agents passed the screening gate with about 40-fold fewer tokens than Codex (GPT-6-Astra) agents and found a candidate with lower validation and held-out errors; only this candidate advanced to self-consistent evaluation. translated_title: 基于物理验证的智能体引导交换-关联泛函发现
translated_abstract: 准确且紧凑的交换-关联泛函是具有预测能力的密度泛函理论的核心。符号搜索和语言模型智能体能够提出新的泛函形式，但目前尚不清楚这些增益能否经受自洽性和外部评估的检验、新项是否蕴含物理内容、智能体是否优于进化搜索，以及不同语言模型骨干之间的表现差异。我们通过模型上下文协议将前沿大语言模型智能体连接到GPU评估器，采用仅训练集拟合、持久记忆以及自洽与外部评估机制。Opus-5.5智能体以比Codex（GPT-6-Astra）智能体少约40倍的token通过了筛选门槛，并找到了一个在验证集和留出集上误差更低的候选泛函；只有该候选泛函晋级进入自洽评估阶段。由此得到的13参数泛函O159通过一个平滑的密度窗口对同自旋关联进行调制。重新拟合的对照实验倾向于一种w……
tldr: 该研究将前沿大语言模型智能体与GPU评估器通过模型上下文协议相连，并引入基于物理的自洽与外部验证流程，最终以远少于对比模型的token用量发现了一个性能更优的13参数交换-关联泛函O159。
en_tdlr: By connecting frontier LLM agents to a GPU evaluator through the Model Context Protocol with physics-based self-consistent and external validation, this work discovers O159, a 13-parameter exchange-correlation functional that passed screening with ~40-fold fewer tokens than competing agents and achieved lower validation and held-out errors.
